en.hubeali:
A number of our copanions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman, from Misma’a Bin Abdul Malik,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘With regards to the heart when it is shaken so it is damaged, is the (complete) wergild’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘With regards to the contortion of the neck is the (complete) wergild; and the contortion is that his neck gets bent and it comes to be on its side’.
